character: An old tengu woman, a crow-headed person, black feathers with a faint grey salt-tarnish, small rings along her beak. Flat black eyes looking down at the viewer, beak closed, perfectly still. One hand raised, fingers mid-count.
wardrobe: A weathered captain's coat, every button a different metal glinting in the light, talons in ship-leather boots, rings on every finger.

full.framing: Full body portrait, low angle looking up at her, she towers over the viewer. Standing in a long dark corridor of numbered iron vault doors, cold light falling from above.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, low angle looking up at her, cold light from above, eyes looking down at the viewer.

scene.framing: Standing at the far end of a long narrow corridor of numbered locked iron doors in a tall dark vault-tower, seen from a low angle, one door open beside her on a bare stone room holding a single ledger on a stand, cold light from above.
